description: On the matches page the kick-off countdown ticks every second, and stays hidden when there is no next match or its kick-off time is to be confirmed

steps.eval: (async () => { const { next } = await (await fetch('/api/matches')).json(); const box = document.querySelector('#countdown'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); if (!next || next.timeTbd || new Date(next.date) < Date.now()) return box.hidden; const first = box.textContent; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1200)); return !box.hidden && /\d{2} s$/.test(box.textContent.trim()) && box.textContent !== first && !box.closest('[aria-live]'); })()
